title: Velvety Slovakian Egg Noodles Braise
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring springy egg noodles in a rich and savory braise, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is sugar-free-friendly and packed with umami flavor.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the pork shoulder pieces on all sides.
Remove the browned pork from the pot and set it aside, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pot and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, caraway seeds, black pepper, and salt to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the browned pork to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions and set them aside.
Stir the sour cream into the braise and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Combine the cooked egg noodles and braise in a large serving dish and toss to combine.
Serve the Velvety Slovakian Egg Noodles Braise hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
